title: Stir-Fried Irish Lettuce
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir-fry recipe featuring Irish lettuce as the main ingredient.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of Tagine in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the mixed bell peppers and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Irish Lettuce and cook until it's wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter.
Garnish with chopped Iceberg Lettuce and serve immediately.
Serve hot over rice or noodles, if desired.
